import java.util.*;

public class Main {
    static int[] dx = {-1, 0, 1, 0};
    static int[] dy = {0, 1, 0, -1};
    static int N;
    static ArrayList<String> mat;
    static ArrayList<String> mat2;
    static int[][] v1;
    static MinCostMaxFlow mcf = new MinCostMaxFlow();

    static class Edge {
        int from, to, cost, flow;
        Edge(int f, int t, int c, int fl) {
            from = f; to = t; cost = c; flow = fl;
        }
    }

    static class MinCostMaxFlow {
        int Nodes;
        ArrayList<Integer> cost, flow, p;
        ArrayList<Edge> edges;
        int tot_cost, tot_flow;
        final int INF = 1000000000;

        void clear(int n) {
            Nodes = n;
            cost = new ArrayList<>(n);
            flow = new ArrayList<>(n);
            p = new ArrayList<>(n);
            for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
                cost.add(INF);
                flow.add(0);
                p.add(0);
            }
            edges = new ArrayList<>();
        }

        void add_edge(int from, int to, int cost, int flow) {
            edges.add(new Edge(from, to, cost, flow));
            edges.add(new Edge(to, from, -cost, 0));
        }

        void get_path(int src, int sink) {
            clear(Nodes);
            flow.set(src, INF);
            cost.set(src, 0);
            boolean updated;
            for (int i = 0; i < Nodes; i++) {
                updated = false;
                for (int j = 0; j < edges.size(); j++) {
                    Edge e = edges.get(j);
                    if (e.flow > 0 && cost.get(e.to) > cost.get(e.from) + e.cost) {
                        updated = true;
                        cost.set(e.to, cost.get(e.from) + e.cost);
                        flow.set(e.to, Math.min(flow.get(e.from), e.flow));
                        p.set(e.to, j);
                    }
                }
                if (!updated) break;
            }
        }

        void cost_flow(int src, int sink) {
            if (src == sink) { tot_cost = 0; tot_flow = INF; return; }
            tot_cost = 0;
            tot_flow = 0;
            while (true) {
                get_path(src, sink);
                if (flow.get(sink) == 0) break;
                for (int cur = sink; cur != src; cur = edges.get(p.get(cur)).from) {
                    int rI = (p.get(cur) % 2 == 0) ? p.get(cur) + 1 : p.get(cur) - 1;
                    edges.get(p.get(cur)).flow -= flow.get(sink);
                    edges.get(rI).flow += flow.get(sink);
                    tot_cost += edges.get(p.get(cur)).cost * flow.get(sink);
                }
                tot_flow += flow.get(sink);
            }
        }

        int get_flow() { return tot_flow; }
        int get_cost() { return tot_cost; }
    }

    static int IN(int a) { return 2 * a; }
    static int OUT(int a) { return 2 * a + 1; }

    static void ff(int x, int y, int[][] v) {
        Queue<Integer> q = new LinkedList<>();
        q.add(x * N + y);
        while (!q.isEmpty()) {
            int cur = q.poll();
            x = cur / N;
            y = cur % N;
            for (int i = 0; i < 4; i++) {
                int nx = x + dx[i];
                int ny = y + dy[i];
                if (nx < 0 || nx >= N || ny < 0 || ny >= N || v[nx][ny] != -1 || mat.get(nx).charAt(ny) == 'Y')
                    continue;
                if (Character.isDigit(mat2.get(nx).charAt(ny)) && mat2.get(nx).charAt(ny) != '0' &&
                    (v[x][y] + 1 <= v1[nx][ny] || v1[nx][ny] == -1)) {
                    v[nx][ny] = v[x][y] + 1;
                    if (v[nx][ny] != v1[nx][ny])
                        q.add(nx * N + ny);
                } else if (v1[nx][ny] == -1 || v1[nx][ny] > v[x][y] + 1) {
                    v[nx][ny] = v[x][y] + 1;
                    q.add(nx * N + ny);
                }
            }
        }
    }

    static void ini(int x, int y, int[][] v) {
        for (int i = 0; i < N; i++) Arrays.fill(v[i], -1);
        v[x][y] = 0;
        ff(x, y, v);
    }

    static ArrayList<int[][]> get(ArrayList<String> m) {
        ArrayList<int[][]> vv = new ArrayList<>(N * N);
        for (int i = 0; i < N * N; i++) vv.add(null);
        for (int i = 0; i < N; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < N; j++) {
                if (Character.isDigit(m.get(i).charAt(j)) && m.get(i).charAt(j) != '0') {
                    int[][] dist = new int[N][N];
                    for (int[] row : dist) Arrays.fill(row, -1);
                    dist[i][j] = 0;
                    ff(i, j, dist);
                    vv.set(i * N + j, dist);
                }
            }
        }
        return vv;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        int n = sc.nextInt();
        int t = sc.nextInt();
        sc.nextLine();
        N = n;
        ArrayList<String> a = new ArrayList<>(n);
        ArrayList<String> b = new ArrayList<>(n);
        int si = 0, sj = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            String line = sc.nextLine();
            a.add(line);
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                if (line.charAt(j) == 'Z') {
                    si = i;
                    sj = j;
                }
            }
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            b.add(sc.nextLine());
        }
        mat = a;
        mat2 = b;

        v1 = new int[N][N];
        for (int[] row : v1) Arrays.fill(row, 1000000);
        int[][] v = new int[N][N];
        for (int[] row : v) Arrays.fill(row, -1);
        v[si][sj] = 0;
        ff(si, sj, v);
        v1 = new int[N][N];
        for (int i = 0; i < N; i++) v1[i] = v[i].clone();

        ArrayList<int[][]> vv = get(a);

        mcf.clear(4 * N * N + 2);
        int src = 4 * N * N;
        int sink = src + 1;
        for (int i = 0; i < N * N; i++) {
            mcf.add_edge(src, IN(i), 0, 1000000);
            mcf.add_edge(OUT(N * N + i), sink, 0, 1000000);
        }

        for (int x = 0; x < N; x++) {
            for (int y = 0; y < N; y++) {
                if (Character.isDigit(a.get(x).charAt(y))) {
                    int k = x * N + y;
                    mcf.add_edge(IN(k), OUT(k), 0, a.get(x).charAt(y) - '0');
                }
                if (Character.isDigit(b.get(x).charAt(y))) {
                    int k = x * N + y + N * N;
                    mcf.add_edge(IN(k), OUT(k), 0, b.get(x).charAt(y) - '0');
                }
            }
        }

        for (int i = 0; i < N; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < N; j++) {
                if (Character.isDigit(b.get(i).charAt(j)) && b.get(i).charAt(j) != '0') {
                    for (int k = 0; k < vv.size(); k++) {
                        if (vv.get(k) != null) {
                            int x = k / N;
                            int y = k % N;
                            if (vv.get(k)[i][j] != -1 && vv.get(k)[i][j] <= t) {
                                int n1 = x * N + y;
                                int n2 = i * N + j + N * N;
                                mcf.add_edge(OUT(n1), IN(n2), 0, 1000000);
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        mcf.cost_flow(src, sink);
        System.out.println(mcf.get_flow());
    }
}
